Admissions Graduate Admissions
Funding & Aid
Thanks for your interest in American University’s graduate programs. The graduate admission process begins within each respective school or college. If you are interested in receiving information about a particular area of study, please explore the schools featured below to learn more about the programs offered, connect with an advisor, or start an application. If you are uncertain about which school houses your prospective area of study, please email us at: gradstudies@american.edu.
American University offers 140+ doctoral, master’s and certificate programs. Whether you are interested in upskilling in your field or advancing your career in business, film, policy, the arts or international affairs, AU offers a vast array of top-ranking academic programs taught by internationally recognized faculty.
Widely known for producing generations of public servants, AU attracts graduate scholars who aspire to further hone their skills, advance research, apply knowledge to the world’s most pressing issues and become an active part of our legacy of bold leadership.
Our Schools & Colleges
College of Arts & Sciences
The College of Arts and Sciences offers more than 50 graduate degrees and certificates in the humanities, arts, sciences, and social sciences. We deliver a combination of academic training and real-world professional experience to turn your passion into impact as a future leader.

Kogod School of Business
Learn by doing is at the center of our business education philosophy. You’ll have opportunities both inside and outside of the classroom to get real-world experience, including consulting projects, co-op programs, the Center for Innovation Entrepreneurship Incubator, and capstones and practicums.
>> Graduate Degrees & Certificates

School of Communication
From journalism to strategic communication to independent filmmaking and games, we inspire tomorrow's digital storytellers. You will learn to produce media that matters with our supportive faculty who achieved the highest honors in their professional field, including Academy and Emmy awards and the Pulitzer Prize.

Baker School of Education
With a vibrant community and passion for change, we are dedicated to creating and ensuring excellent learning experiences for every child. Through cutting-edge research, innovative outreach programs, and the development of inspiring coursework, you will address the most challenging issues in the field.

School of International Service
As a top-10 school of international affairs, we prepare you for global service in the government, nonprofit, and businesses sectors while connecting you to an active network of more than 25,000 alumni. Our students graduate prepared to combine knowledge with practice to wage peace in the world.

School of Public Affairs
The School of Public Affairs is a top-ranked school of public administration and policy, government, and justice. From our politically-engaged campus, you gain access to world-class faculty members, influencers, and internship opportunities where you can have a meaningful impact on our world.

Washington College of Law
As a nationally ranked law school, we provide you with the critical skills and values to have an immediate impact in Washington, DC, our nation, and around the world.

Professional & Executive Education
Whether you seek to upskill or reskill, our professional and executive training will meet you where you are in your career. We offer learning options that fit both your schedule and career aspirations.
